# SourciaVera

> Independent third-party factory verification and sourcing for auto parts buyers in Latin America, primarily Mexico. Based in Guangzhou, China. We verify wheels, carbon fiber parts, LED lighting, and OEM/ODM private-label auto parts factories before you pay — and the same verification process covers any product category. Entry point: a $49 Remote Supplier Check (company registration, manufacturer-vs-trader, address and payment-account consistency; written report within 48 hours of receiving payment and the supplier details; not a substitute for an on-site visit — the $49 is credited toward a full on-site verification if you continue). Full on-site factory verification starts at $449 per visit ($399/man-day pre-shipment inspection, $499/man-day factory audit), reports delivered within 48 hours. Zero factory commissions — we work for buyers only.
